From: NexaTech Expo Registration
To: Dana Whitfield
Date: April 28
Subject: Registration confirmed - NexaTech Expo 2026

Dear Ms. Whitfield,

We are pleased to confirm your registration for NexaTech Expo 2026, which will take place on May 12 and 13 at the Riverfront Convention Center. Your Innovation Pass covers both days of the expo, all keynote presentations, and the networking reception on the evening of May 12. We look forward to welcoming you.

Sincerely,
NexaTech Registration Team

questionText: What does Ms. Whitfield's Innovation Pass include?

options.text: (A) Admission to the May 11 workshops
(B) A reserved seat at every presentation
(C) Both days of the expo and the May 12 reception
(D) Transportation to the Riverfront Convention Center

translation: Thẻ Innovation Pass của bà Whitfield bao gồm những gì?
explanation: E-mail nêu rõ pass 'covers both days of the expo, all keynote presentations, and the networking reception on the evening of May 12', còn chương trình xác nhận kỳ hội nghị diễn ra ngày 12-13/5 và lễ giao lưu vào 6:30 tối ngày 12/5. Ghép hai thông tin này, C đúng. A sai vì e-mail nói pass không gồm workshop ngày 11/5; B sai vì chỉ phiên 'AI in Manufacturing' cần đặt chỗ trước, không phải mọi phiên; D sai vì bài không đề cập phương tiện đưa đón.

vocab.meaning: tiệc tiếp khách, buổi giao lưu

passageTitle: Questions 181-185 refer to the following order confirmation and e-mail.
passageHtml:
Order Confirmation - Copperline Office Furnishings

Order no.: CD-2291
Customer: Marlowe Design Studio, Suite 400, 18 Mercer Street
Order date: September 2
Scheduled delivery: September 9

Items

  • 6 Ergonomic Task Chairs - $185 each - $1,110
  • 2 Height-Adjustable Desks - $640 each - $1,280
  • 1 Oak Conference Table - $950 - $950

Subtotal: $3,340
Delivery and standard setup: $120
Total: $3,460

Note: White-glove assembly is included for the desks and conference table only. Chairs are shipped flat-packed.

E-mail

From: Nadia Cole, Operations Manager, Marlowe Design Studio
To: Customer Service, Copperline Office Furnishings
Date: September 9
Subject: Order CD-2291 - incomplete delivery

The truck arrived this morning, but the delivery was not complete. We received five chairs, one of which has a cracked frame, and the two desks. The conference table was not on the truck. The driver told our receptionist that the table is backordered until September 20.

We have a client presentation on September 16 and cannot hold it without the table. Please arrange for a replacement chair to be delivered by September 12 and the conference table by September 15. If the table cannot arrive by then, cancel it and refund the $950. Because the delay is affecting our business, we also expect a 10 percent discount on the table. I have attached photos of the damaged chair.

Regards,
Nadia Cole
questionText: What is the value of the undamaged furniture that Marlowe Design Studio received?
translation: Giá trị của số nội thất không bị hư mà Marlowe Design Studio đã nhận là bao nhiêu?
explanation: E-mail cho biết công ty nhận được 5 ghế nhưng 1 ghế bị nứt khung, tức chỉ 4 ghế còn tốt, cùng 2 bàn làm việc. Đơn giá trong bảng xác nhận là 185 đô-la/ghế và 640 đô-la/bàn, nên giá trị còn tốt là 4 × 185 + 2 × 640 = 740 + 1.280 = 2.020 đô-la, đáp án D. A là giá trị nếu tính cả chiếc ghế bị hỏng; B và C không khớp với số lượng và đơn giá trong chứng từ.

vocab.meaning: được đóng gói dạng tấm rời

MEMORANDUM
To: Regional Sales Managers
From: Elena Park, Marketing Director
Date: October 4
Subject: Third-Quarter Results for the "City Kitchen" Campaign

Thank you for your support during the third-quarter launch of our City Kitchen line of compact countertop appliances. As shown in the attached summary table, overall unit sales rose by 24 percent compared with the second quarter, and traffic to our product recipes page more than doubled.

While online video ads generated strong awareness among younger buyers, our post-purchase survey showed that live weekend cooking demonstrations in partner stores produced the highest conversion rate. Based on these findings, we are adjusting our fourth-quarter promotional budget and expanding the demonstration program for the holiday shopping season.

City Kitchen Campaign — Q3 Results & Q4 Budget Plan

Website Traffic+110% (Doubled vs. Q2)Add 15 new video recipes
In-Store Cooking Demos / Sampling#1 driver of completed purchasesExpand to 12 additional stores in November

COASTAL RAIL AUTHORITY — NEW WEEKDAY EXPRESS SERVICE

Beginning Monday, May 4, the Coastal Rail Authority will introduce a weekday morning and evening express train between Fairview Station and Harbor Point Terminal, with a single intermediate stop at Millbrook Junction. Designed for daily commuters, the express service completes the trip in 38 minutes—12 minutes faster than the regular local line.

Each express train consists of four newly refurbished carriages with complimentary Wi-Fi and power outlets at every seat. Please review the timetable and rider alert below for ticketing rules, bicycle storage limits, and temporary maintenance adjustments in June.

Coastal Rail Weekday Express — Schedule & Train Configuration

Direction / FeatureSchedule / CapacityRider Guidelines
Morning Southbound ExpressDeparts Fairview 7:10 a.m. → Millbrook 7:28 a.m. → Arrives Harbor Point 7:48 a.m.38-minute total travel time (saves 12 min)
Evening Northbound ExpressDeparts Harbor Point 5:45 p.m. → Millbrook 6:05 p.m. → Arrives Fairview 6:23 p.m.Subject to June 2–13 track work (see alert)
Seating & Bicycle Racks96 seats per carriage; racks for 6 bicycles per trainBike spaces are first-come, first-served
Designated Quiet CarLast carriage (Rear car of the train)No phone calls; silence mobile devices

RIDER ALERT — TICKETING & JUNE TRACK MAINTENANCE

Ticketing Policy: Standard monthly passes and single-ride tickets are valid on the Express at no extra fare. However, tickets must be purchased before boarding via the Coastal Rail mobile app or station vending machines; conductors do not accept cash on board.

June 2–13 Track Maintenance: Due to evening rail replacement work near Millbrook Viaduct from June 2 through June 13, the 5:45 p.m. return express from Harbor Point will be replaced by an express motorcoach bus. Please allow an additional 20 minutes of travel time during this two-week period.

(D) To explain how to apply for a monthly pass

translation: Mục đích của thông báo là gì?
explanation: Thông báo giới thiệu tuyến express mới giữa Fairview và Harbor Point từ ngày 2/6, đồng thời nêu việc chuyến tàu chiều 5:45 sẽ tạm thời được thay bằng xe buýt từ 2/6 đến 13/6 do sửa đường ray. Vì vậy A đúng. B sai vì không có thay đổi giá vé; C sai vì Millbrook là điểm dừng hiện có, không phải ga mới; D sai vì không hướng dẫn đăng ký vé tháng.

vocab.meaning: tàu chạy nhanh, ít điểm dừng
khởi chạy, đưa vào hoạt động

passageTitle: Questions 196-200 refer to the following service announcement, timetable, and rider alert:
passageHtml:
COASTAL RAIL AUTHORITY — NEW WEEKDAY EXPRESS SERVICE

Beginning Monday, May 4, the Coastal Rail Authority will introduce a weekday morning and evening express train between Fairview Station and Harbor Point Terminal, with a single intermediate stop at Millbrook Junction. Designed for daily commuters, the express service completes the trip in 38 minutes—12 minutes faster than the regular local line.

Each express train consists of four newly refurbished carriages with complimentary Wi-Fi and power outlets at every seat. Please review the timetable and rider alert below for ticketing rules, bicycle storage limits, and temporary maintenance adjustments in June.

Coastal Rail Weekday Express — Schedule & Train Configuration

Direction / FeatureSchedule / CapacityRider Guidelines
Morning Southbound ExpressDeparts Fairview 7:10 a.m. → Millbrook 7:28 a.m. → Arrives Harbor Point 7:48 a.m.38-minute total travel time (saves 12 min)
Evening Northbound ExpressDeparts Harbor Point 5:45 p.m. → Millbrook 6:05 p.m. → Arrives Fairview 6:23 p.m.Subject to June 2–13 track work (see alert)
Seating & Bicycle Racks96 seats per carriage; racks for 6 bicycles per trainBike spaces are first-come, first-served
Designated Quiet CarLast carriage (Rear car of the train)No phone calls; silence mobile devices

RIDER ALERT — TICKETING & JUNE TRACK MAINTENANCE

Ticketing Policy: Standard monthly passes and single-ride tickets are valid on the Express at no extra fare. However, tickets must be purchased before boarding via the Coastal Rail mobile app or station vending machines; conductors do not accept cash on board.

June 2–13 Track Maintenance: Due to evening rail replacement work near Millbrook Viaduct from June 2 through June 13, the 5:45 p.m. return express from Harbor Point will be replaced by an express motorcoach bus. Please allow an additional 20 minutes of travel time during this two-week period.
questionText: How much faster is the new express service than the current service?

options.text: (A) 6 minutes
(B) 12 minutes
(C) 20 minutes
(D) 38 minutes

translation: Tuyến express mới nhanh hơn tuyến hiện tại bao nhiêu phút?
explanation: Thông báo nêu tuyến express đến Harbor Point trong 38 phút, '12 minutes faster than the current service', nên B đúng. A không được nhắc đến; C là khoảng thời gian hành khách nên dự phòng thêm khi đi xe buýt thay thế; D là tổng thời gian di chuyển của tuyến express, không phải mức chênh lệch.

questionText: What is true about the replacement buses?

options.text: (A) They leave earlier than the train did.
(B) They require a separate reservation.
(C) They stop at every station on the line.
(D) They accept monthly passes without an extra charge.

translation: Điều gì đúng về các xe buýt thay thế?
explanation: Thông báo nêu: 'Monthly pass holders may board the replacement buses at no extra charge; single-ride tickets will be honored as well', nên D đúng. A sai vì bài chỉ nói hành khách nên dự phòng thêm 20 phút, không nói xe rời sớm hơn; B sai vì không yêu cầu đặt chỗ riêng; C sai vì không có thông tin về các điểm dừng của xe buýt.

questionText: How can passengers purchase a ticket?

options.text: (A) Through the app or at station vending machines
(B) With cash from the conductor on board
(C) By calling the station at least one day ahead

translation: Hành khách có thể mua vé bằng cách nào?
explanation: Thông báo cho biết: 'Tickets can be purchased through the Coastal Rail app or at station vending machines', nên A đúng. B sai vì 'Cash will no longer be accepted on board'; C sai vì không có hình thức mua qua điện thoại; D sai vì đặt chỗ không bắt buộc và không phải cách duy nhất để mua vé.

questionText: What can be inferred about passengers who want to use the quiet car?

options.text: (A) They must reserve a seat in advance.
(B) They should board the last carriage.
(C) They must pay an additional fee.
(D) They cannot bring bicycles on the train.

translation: Có thể suy ra điều gì về hành khách muốn sử dụng toa yên tĩnh?
explanation: Thông báo nêu 'a quiet car will be located at the rear', tức toa yên tĩnh nằm ở cuối tàu, nên hành khách nên lên toa cuối cùng; B đúng. A sai vì thông báo nói không cần đặt chỗ trước; C sai vì không có phụ phí cho toa yên tĩnh; D sai vì tàu có chỗ cho sáu xe đạp, không có quy định cấm mang xe đạp.
